ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark-gray/black) pixels with a ratio of approximately 98% low-intensity to 2% high-intensity pixels localized in discrete points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment across both lobes. No macro-scale mottling or contiguous white geometric blobs. Sparse high-contrast (yellow-white) pixel clusters representing discrete points of interest.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 0.4 relative to the central fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the primary boundary. A distinct macroscopic semi-circular indentation (approx. 15 pixels deep) is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Highly convex leading edge curve transitioning to a shallow concave sweep on the outer trailing edge, returning to a convex curve as it approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast yellow-white circular clusters. Left lobe: linear chain of 3 spots (mid-distal) and a cluster of 4 spots (proximal-lower). Right lobe: arc of 6 circular clusters in the mid-fluke region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct fine-line white pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) oriented diagonally on the left lobe near the median notch boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/trauma-related defect is present on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
